call_points.text: Iron ore EBITDA margins expected to be maintained at 42-43% in FY27.
No immediate plans to leverage; capex to be funded via internal resources unless big acquisitions occur.
Sanctioned ₹3,000 Cr for Vizag blending yard to launch India's first branded iron ore.
Gold mining in Australia barely breaking even due to high refining costs; refinery planned.

operating_notes.text: April 2026 iron ore production stood at 4.64 MT and sales at 3.68 MT.
Q4FY26 iron ore production reached 162.72 LT and sales 152.99 LT.
May 2026 production stood at 5.3 MT against 4.4 MT last year.
Production cost in Bailadila reduced from ~₹1,000/t to ~₹800/t in FY26.
Sanctioned ₹3,000 Cr for a blending yard at Vizag for branded iron ore.

timeline.summary: NMDC reported April 2026 iron ore production of 4.64 MT and sales of 3.68 MT.
NMDC Limited fixed Iron Ore prices: Baila Lump ₹5,500/ton, Baila Fines ₹4,700/ton effective 06 May 2026 via Pravin Shekhar.
President of India (Promoter) disclosed 534,49,00,713 (60.79%) shares held as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrance during FY2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹11,343.13 Cr, net profit ₹2,027.23 Cr.
NMDC reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹11,173 Cr and net profit of ₹2,020 Cr, driven by a 22% YoY jump in iron ore production.
NMDC Limited shared the audio recording of its Analyst/Investor Conference Call on June 1, 2026, discussing Q4 & FY 2025–26 audited financial results via its website.
NMDC Limited, signed by Pravin Shekhar, announced Iron Ore prices effective June 3, 2026: Baila Lump ₹5,700/ton, Baila Fines ₹4,850/ton.
NMDC guided for 60 MT production in FY27 and announced a ₹40,000-50,000 Cr capex plan over three years to reach 100 MT capacity.
